description: Reserve a free 1 GiB, 30-minute proxy trial using an inbound from get_service_info. Returns an ID and secret access_token. This has side effects, consumes a slot, and is not idempotent. If ready is false, poll get_trial_status. Never publish or log the token.

inbound.description: An inbound identifier from get_service_info, such as in-1443-hysteria or in-443-tcp.

name: create_trial
